name: confirm-button
title: Confirm Button
description: A button that asks twice, built with definePrimitive: the first press arms it (data-armed, its text and name become labels.armed, announced), the second runs onConfirm; it disarms on a timeout, Escape or blur with change reasons, can confirm on a hold, and carries data-agent-confirm.
docs: `<ConfirmButton agentConfirm onConfirm timeout hold variant size labels>` with the idle content as children. The first press arms it: `data-armed`, the destructive fill, and the text (and so the name) becomes `armedChildren` or `labels.armed` ("Press again to confirm"), read politely to screen readers; both contents share one grid cell, so the width holds. The second press runs `onConfirm({ reason, event })`; a returned Promise sets `aria-busy` and `data-pending` with a spinner until it settles. `onArmedChange(armed, details)` reports `trigger-press`, `timeout` (after `timeout` ms, 4000 by default, 0 for never), `escape-key` (Escape only while armed, so a dialog around an idle button still closes), `focus-out` and `confirm`; `details.cancel()` keeps it idle, and `armed`/`defaultArmed` control it. `hold={ms}` also confirms on a held pointer, Enter or Space, filling the button over `--confirm-hold-duration`; a second press still works, for people who can't hold. `agentConfirm` becomes `data-agent-confirm`, so an agent's `confirm` waits for a person through `allow`. For a decision that needs explaining, use `ConfirmDialog`.
